question: Should this member-authored, maintainer-labeled SQLite reliability proof proceed through normal maintainer review once its behind-base head and checks are refreshed?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and member authorship require explicit maintainer handling, and the review environment could not complete the source/history audit needed to substitute an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Review the refreshed head
options.body: Confirm the interruption proof targets the real doctor compaction paths and cannot pass after a committed VACUUM, then merge if the refreshed checks and Testbox evidence remain clean.

options.title: Request narrower proof details
options.body: Ask for the exact force-kill phase evidence and refreshed artifact output if maintainers cannot establish the pre-commit invariant from the code review alone.
